name: Returning Home
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A priestess recently visited our halls seeking you out, young friend. She said that she was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out a Priestess Alathea--she will tell you more.

The Light be with you, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText: Wonderful, you've returned home, adventurer. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 10, 210 XP in all.

quests.name: Returning Home
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
